subtests.name: Reducing a select's size to 1 selects the first enabled option.
Removing a select's multiple attribute selects the first enabled option.
Removing an option's disabled attribute selects it.
Removing an optgroup's disabled attribute selects the option inside it.
Adding an option's selected attribute deselects the other options.
Removing an option's selected attribute falls back to the first enabled option.
Removing the selected attribute from a dirty option does not change selectedness.
Removing a select's multiple attribute keeps the first selected option.
